verdict.rationale: Sketch has a well-documented plugin API (developer.sketch.com) offering a vanilla JavaScript API fully supported between releases, live in-app try-it examples, access to macOS frameworks, and a dedicated plugin manager (skpm) for publishing/distributing plugins; community evidence corroborates an active plugin ecosystem built on this API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on tutorial walkthroughs, TypeScript-specific typings confirmation, and richer sample-code repositories beyond the single 'Hello Sketch' snippet.
